INSERT INTO customer_report( customer_id, conversion_status_code, action_item_id, report_type_code, report_url, send_status_code )
VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{actionItemId}, #{reportTypeCode}, #{reportUrl}, #{sendStatusCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT wr.id AS webFormId, wr.height, wr.weight, wr.selected_priority_category AS selectedPriorityCategory, wr.history_json AS historyJson, wr.activity_json AS activityJson, wr.past_surgery_or_hospitalization AS pastSurgeryOrHospitalization, wr.desired_budget_code AS desiredBudgetCode, wr.received_at AS receivedAt FROM webform_response wr WHERE wr.id = #{webFormId}

SELECT cgs.age AS ageMonth, cgs.height_p5 AS heightP5, cgs.height_p50 AS heightP50, cgs.height_p95 AS heightP95, cgs.weight_p5 AS weightP5, cgs.weight_p50 AS weightP50, cgs.weight_p95 AS weightP95 FROM cdc_growth_standard cgs WHERE TRIM(cgs.gender) IN ( #{gender}, CASE #{gender} WHEN 'MALE' THEN 'M' WHEN 'FEMALE' THEN 'F' ELSE #{gender} END ) AND cgs.age BETWEEN #{minAge} AND #{maxAge} ORDER BY cgs.age

SELECT cds.disease_code AS diseaseCode, cds.disease_name AS diseaseName, cds.treatment_type AS treatmentType, cds.patient_count AS patientCount, cds.rank_by_age_gender AS `rank`, category.category_code AS categoryCode, category.category_name AS categoryName, coverage.coverage_name AS coverageName FROM cdc_disease_statistic cds LEFT JOIN insurance_coverage coverage ON coverage.id = cds.target_coverage_id LEFT JOIN insurance_category category ON category.category_code = coverage.category_code WHERE cds.data_year = ( SELECT MAX(latest.data_year) FROM cdc_disease_statistic latest WHERE TRIM(latest.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} ) AND TRIM(cds.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND (cds.gender = #{gender} OR cds.gender = 'ALL') AND cds.treatment_type = #{treatmentType} ORDER BY CASE WHEN cds.gender = #{gender} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cds.rank_by_age_gender, cds.patient_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cds.disease_code AS diseaseCode, cds.disease_name AS diseaseName, cds.treatment_type AS treatmentType, cds.patient_count AS patientCount, cds.rank_by_age_gender AS `rank`, category.category_code AS categoryCode, category.category_name AS categoryName, coverage.coverage_name AS coverageName FROM cdc_disease_statistic cds LEFT JOIN insurance_coverage coverage ON coverage.id = cds.target_coverage_id LEFT JOIN insurance_category category ON category.category_code = coverage.category_code WHERE cds.data_year = ( SELECT MAX(latest.data_year) FROM cdc_disease_statistic latest WHERE TRIM(latest.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND latest.gender = #{gender} ) AND TRIM(cds.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND cds.gender = #{gender} ORDER BY cds.patient_count DESC, cds.rank_by_age_gender LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cds.data_year AS dataYear, cds.treatment_type AS treatmentType, COUNT(*) AS diseaseCount, SUM(cds.patient_count) AS totalPatientCount, MAX(cds.patient_count) AS maxPatientCount FROM cdc_disease_statistic cds WHERE cds.data_year = ( SELECT MAX(latest.data_year) FROM cdc_disease_statistic latest WHERE TRIM(latest.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND latest.gender = #{gender} ) AND TRIM(cds.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND cds.gender = #{gender} GROUP BY cds.data_year, cds.treatment_type ORDER BY SUM(cds.patient_count) DESC

SELECT c.id AS contractId, c.policy_number AS policyNumber, contractor.name AS contractorName, COALESCE(potential_insured.name, integrated_insured.name, '-') AS insuredName, COALESCE(product.product_name, '-') AS productName, COALESCE(category.category_name, '-') AS categoryName, COALESCE(contract_status.code_name, '-') AS contractStatusName, COALESCE(result_status.code_name, '-') AS contractResultStatusName, c.created_at AS contractDate FROM contract c LEFT JOIN integrated_customer contractor ON contractor.integrated_customer_id = c.integrated_customer_id LEFT JOIN potential_customer potential_insured ON c.conversion_status_code = '01' AND potential_insured.id = c.insured_id LEFT JOIN integrated_customer integrated_insured ON c.conversion_status_code = '02' AND integrated_insured.integrated_customer_id = c.insured_id LEFT JOIN insurance_product product ON product.id = c.insurance_product_id LEFT JOIN insurance_category category ON category.category_code = product.category_code LEFT JOIN common_code contract_status ON contract_status.group_code = 'CONTRACT_STATUS' AND contract_status.code_value = c.contract_status_code LEFT JOIN common_code result_status ON result_status.group_code = 'CONTRACT_RESULT_STATUS' AND result_status.code_value = c.contract_result_status_code WHERE c.integrated_customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cr.report_url FROM customer_report cr LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc ON cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.id = cr.customer_id LEFT JOIN integrated_customer ic ON cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.integrated_customer_id = cr.customer_id WHERE cr.id = #{reportId} AND ( (cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}) OR (cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}) ) LIMIT 1
